sources.purpose: Current hunting_prize menu and visibility rules
Delayed pig assignment and resistance branch
Shared generated stock and trophy landing
Slave/assistant battle settlement shares the same later trophy flow

actions.label: 전리품을 강간한다
actions.guard: The menu removes this choice after hunting_prize becomes 2; the handler itself has no matching entry guard.
actions.shared: Only this trophy menu directly references this menu key. Existing age branches share this handler.
actions.scopeNote: Sensitive narrative and sexual/age-effect implementation details are deliberately omitted; this audit records only bookkeeping entry and existing repeat-state behavior.

actions.label: 데리고 간다
actions.guard: stock_to_slave_nogt returns 0 and exits if stock_state is not slave_exist; current 61132 ignores its return value.
actions.successState: stock/slave swap succeeds and stock is consumed in the expected empty-slave case.
actions.shared: stock_to_slave_nogt is shared by ordinary acquisitions and by trophy pig, prison and cryo routes.
actions.recommendation: Count only this selected route after conversion success. Do not attach the positive delta globally to stock_to_slave_nogt.

actions.label: 외양간 돼지로 만든다
actions.guard: No trophy-handler preflight beyond the menu. interaction6007 can transfer control to a resistance fight before the delayed swap.
actions.successState: The actual slave-to-pig swap is deferred to $special_action[1].
actions.shared: interaction6007 is also normal barn management for owned slaves.
actions.recommendation: Distinguish successful pig assignment from click/initial stock conversion. Bind any pending trophy transaction to its origin and consume it once at the real successful assignment.

actions.label: 크라이오 보관소에 넣는다
actions.menuGate: prize_cryo_nr>0; first free permitted external-storage cell selected by the menu.
actions.guard: stock_to_slave checks stock_to_slave_nogt success, but 61136 has no own occupancy/provenance recheck.
actions.successState: Prize is stored in the selected cell; any previous current slave is restored.
actions.shared: Both conversion and cryo-swap helpers are shared across normal game acquisition/storage.
actions.recommendation: Keep the zero change; do not inherit the positive take-home effect from the shared conversion helper.

actions.label: 스파크용으로 도축한다
actions.menuGate: Always shown in the current trophy menu.
actions.handler: interaction_city -> existing meat evaluation -> money -> clear stock
actions.guard: No stock/hunting_prize preflight in this handler.
actions.shared: The meat-evaluation and stock-clear dependencies are general helpers, not unique moral-action boundaries.
actions.recommendation: Validate a still-pending existing stock before any payout; account only once with the actual terminal disposition, not in meat valuation.

actions.label: 고기용 도축하기 ($5)
actions.menuGate: Always shown, without a menu balance gate.
actions.handler: interaction_city -> charge/evaluate -> production counters -> clear stock -> get_meat
actions.guard: No stock/hunting_prize/balance preflight in this handler.
actions.successState: $5 charged; meat production counters updated; stock cleared; inventory meat awarded.
actions.shared: Evaluation and get_meat are common production helpers.
actions.recommendation: Keep the existing accounting sequence and award the disposition effect once after a valid pending-stock transaction. Repainting result pages must not execute settlement again.

actions.label: 경매에 부친다
actions.menuGate: Always shown in the trophy menu.
actions.guard: Deposit validates existing stock, positive valuation and successful escrow copy before clearing stock. Handler branches to a failure screen when result is not 1.
actions.successState: Escrow gets a preserved copy; stock is cleared; deposit result=1.
actions.shared: Escrow return/collect/next-day settlement/panel are general auction facilities. Numeric city_form119 is an unrelated route namespace.
actions.recommendation: Keep zero effect and existing escrow success checks. Do not assign moral effects to the common escrow helper.

actions.label: 감방에 가둔다
actions.menuGate: A current slave exists; dungeon=1; prisoner_state=no_slave.
actions.guard: Only menu capacity conditions; slave_to_cage resets hunting_prize after recognizing the trophy.
actions.successState: Prize is in the prison and original current slave restored.
actions.recommendation: No value was specified in the user-approved list; do not implicitly grant the take-home bonus through the common acquisition helper.

acquisitionFlow.sharedFlow: выход_из_боя settles the companion via jo9_fog_relay.finish, later closes relay state, then get_girl=1 generates stock and enters interaction_city61120. Companion victories use the same stock disposition menu.
acquisitionFlow.generationIsNotOwnership: get_girl=1/generate_stock/61120 only produce a pending trophy; ownership begins after a selected route succeeds.
trophyFlagLifecycle: 61121 changes it to2 for its existing nonterminal-menu state
slave_to_cage resets it to0 for that transfer
acquisitionFlow.conversionResult: stock_to_slave_nogt uses result=0, rejects absent stock, swaps only a valid stock, then returns result=1.
acquisitionFlow.stockTypeIsNotEpisodeId: Do not use stock_type alone to deduplicate a trophy: repeated trophies may have the same template ID.

existingMenu.label: 전리품을 풀어 준다
existingMenu.handler: interaction_city8994 sets safari.slave=0 and returns the safari result menu

release.proof: All current jo9_cruel_mercy writes are init_game=0 and jo9_battle_fate choice -1/+1. No release handler adds to it.
release.scope: This release belongs to the Exclusion Zone safari content, not the standard edge_patrol hunting_prize menu.

duplicationRisks: Menu visibility is not an operation-level success guard; direct/cached action re-entry can still reach several handlers.
Shared stock_to_slave_nogt cannot identify the selected disposition: take-home, pig, prison and cryo all call it.

interaction_screen and interaction_screen_city execute $special_action[txt] whenever nonempty and do not clear it immediately. A delayed pig action requires a one-time transaction check, not an assumption that render callbacks are once-only.
The pig conversion may be interrupted by resistance; initial click or stock-to-slave conversion alone does not prove final pig assignment.
Keep separate accounting for any allowed nonterminal action and a later terminal disposition; a single already-awarded flag would incorrectly suppress the second approved effect.
Do not clear hunting_prize early solely as a duplicate flag: stock_to_slave and slave_to_cage already use it for existing return/transfer behavior.
Several handlers clear stock only after applying cash/cost/production; missing-stock preflight is needed before a repeat settlement could award another value.
recommendedBoundary: For nonzero terminal values, use the explicitly selected trophy route, validate current pending stock and successful destination transition, then settle once. Preserve shared helpers, return flow, ordinary purchases/storage and zero-value routes.
numericNote: The existing jo9_cruel_mercy field is currently updated in integer units. Representing user-approved half-points requires an explicit compatible numeric strategy; this audit does not implement or choose one.
sensitiveScope: The existing 61121 handler shares age-specific branches including the loli_age constant. No sensitive narrative, image code, sexual mechanics or age rules were reproduced in this artifact or changed.
limits: Static compiled-QSP and menu-JSON inspection only; not a native execution, GUI test, save replay or proof that every repeated-entry risk occurs during ordinary mouse play.
No production QSP/image/save file was changed.
The prison disposition has no approved score; this audit leaves it unassigned.
